question: _________ mode is used whenever either end of the security association is a security gateway.  (RRB JE CE (19/09/2019) Shift 1 CBT 2)
options: Gateway
Tunnel
Encapsulating
Transport
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Tunnel

Explanation:
Tunnel mode is used in IPsec security associations when at least one end is a security gateway. In this mode, the entire original IP packet is encrypted and authenticated, and then encapsulated in a new IP header. This ensures secure communication between gateways, such as in VPNs. Unlike Transport mode, which only protects the payload, Tunnel mode hides the entire packet. It provides network layer security and is widely used in virtual private networks to connect different sites securely over the internet.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ IPsec Tunnel mode → Encrypts entire IP packet and adds new header.
☛ IPsec Transport mode → Encrypts only payload, not header.
☛ Tunnel mode use → When either end of security association is a security gateway.
☛ VPN use → Tunnel mode is used in site-to-site VPNs.
☛ Transport mode use → Used for end-to-end communication between two hosts.
question_hi: _________ मोड का उपयोग तब किया जाता है, जब भी सिक्योरिटी एसोशिएसन का कोई एक सिरा सिक्योरिटी गेटवे होता है।  (RRB JE CE (19/09/2019) Shift 1 CBT 2)
options_hi: गेटवे
टनेल
एनकैप्सुलेटिंग
ट्रांसपोर्ट
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है टनेल

Explanation:
टनेल मोड का उपयोग IPsec सुरक्षा संघों में तब किया जाता है जब कम से कम एक सिरा सुरक्षा गेटवे होता है। इस मोड में पूरे मूल IP पैकेट को एन्क्रिप्ट और प्रमाणित किया जाता है, और फिर इसे एक नए IP हेडर में समाहित किया जाता है। यह गेटवे के बीच सुरक्षित संचार सुनिश्चित करता है, जैसे VPN में। ट्रांसपोर्ट मोड के विपरीत, जो केवल पेलोड को सुरक्षित करता है, टनेल मोड पूरे पैकेट को छुपाता है। यह नेटवर्क परत पर सुरक्षा प्रदान करता है और वर्चुअल प्राइवेट नेटवर्क में व्यापक रूप से उपयोग होता है।

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ VPN में टनेल मोड → साइट-टू-साइट VPN में उपयोग होता है।
☛ ट्रांसपोर्ट मोड उपयोग → एंड-टू-एंड संचार में दो होस्ट के बीच।

question: The movement of modern architecture started in the year of- (RRB JE CE (19/09/2019) Shift 1 CBT 2)
options: 1932
1920
1922
1930
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1920

Explanation:
The modern architecture movement began in the 1920s. It broke away from traditional styles and emphasized new construction principles. Key pioneers include Le Corbusier, Walter Gropius, and Frank Lloyd Wright. The Bauhaus School (founded in 1919) also promoted modernist ideas. The 1920s saw the rise of the International Style, which focused on simplicity, functionality, and the rejection of ornamentation. This movement influenced architecture worldwide, leading to minimalist designs and the use of modern materials like steel, glass, and concrete.

question: Which great personality of the world was also known as 'Fuehrer'? (RRB JE EE (19/09/2019) Shift 2 CBT 2)
options: Napoleon Bonaparte

question: Which industry flourishes in Nepanagar?  (RRB JE EE (19/09/2019) Shift 2 CBT 2)
options: Cement Industry
Sugar Industry
Chemical Industry
Paper Industry
solution:

Explanation:
Nepanagar is located in Burhanpur district of Madhya Pradesh. This place is famous for the paper industry. It houses Nepa Mills (National Newsprint and Paper Mills), which is India's first newsprint factory. It was established in 1955. Nepa Mills produces newsprint and other types of paper. question: Which of the following is NOT a world heritage site? (RRB JE EE (19/09/2019) Shift 2 CBT 2)

question: In which Indian city is the largest post office located? (RRB JE (29/05/2019) Shift 2 CBT 1)

Mumbai
Bengaluru

question: In which year was the Asiatic Cheetah declared extinct in India? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (14/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: 1952
1947
1950
1948
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1952

Explanation:
The Asiatic Cheetah (Acinonyx jubatus venaticus) was declared extinct in India in 1952. Overhunting, habitat loss, and disruption of prey base were the primary causes. This subspecies once roamed dry regions of central India, Rajasthan, and Gujarat. In 2022, under Project Cheetah, India translocated African cheetahs from Namibia and South Africa for reintroduction, but the Asiatic cheetah remains extinct in the wild. It is listed as Critically Endangered on the IUCN Red List.
